set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces [interface_name].explanation: The command configures a specific network interface (`[interface_name]`) on a Junos device, allowing you to define its properties like IP address, MTU, or operational status.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured

unit [unit_number] family [family_type].explanation: Configure an interface with a specific IP address and subnet mask

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The protocol family type (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask in CIDR notation

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface

parameters.name: encapsulation_type
parameters.explanation: The encapsulation type to be set on the interface

unit [unit_number] vlan-id [vlan_id].explanation: Configure VLAN ID for a specific interface unit

parameters.name: vlan_id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID to be set for the interface unit

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
